BatshitTechnology.Showcases.ShowcaseDef.summary: Every device at work, then several of them exploding on schedule.
BatshitTechnology.Showcases.ShowcaseDef.description:
A working Batshit Technology base, built on a fresh map with every project researched: a fuelled Batshittium Reactor powering a stocked Random Replicator, the Transmogrifier on a bill of rock chunks, a colonist in the Brain Squeezer, the Artificer making bolts, and a Batshit Ballista firing 16-bolt volleys at open ground.

Then the demonstrations. A lone Random Replicator and a lone Batshittium Reactor self-destruct in the far corners, a colonist throws an Ergonomic Singularity Grenade at a junk pile with a volunteer in it, and the camera visits AnyRim, a small test town built for exactly this.

Colonists are moved clear of each self-destruct. The volunteer was not consulted.
